text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No matter how much I run, I just… can't seem to ride the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Why does my body feel so heavy? What could be causing this feeling?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Perhaps my problem is a corporeal one? I do feel that my calorie intake has been on the up recently.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If I'm to become the wind, I'll need to lighten myself…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I must practice discipline to become a light and refreshing breeze!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to become the wind, Yamanin Zephyr redoubles her efforts until she successfully gets back to her ideal weight.
